summary.text: Mikhail Alterman is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works in information technology and, in a Ballotpedia survey, named lowering the cost of living and school choice as his main campaign focuses.

paragraphs.text: Mikhail Alterman earned a high school diploma from Cleveland Heights University Heights High School and a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from Case Western Reserve University in 1998, with a minor in economics.
His career experience includes working in information technology.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Alterman's campaign biography described decades of activism on the east side of Cuyahoga County in civic and religious organizations.
He listed lower cost of living, school choice and cutting waste as key messages, saying fees, income, sales and property taxes are too high on the east side of Cuyahoga County.
He also said water and sewer departments should report to the Public Utilities Commission and called for expanding school choice to the maximum.
